meaning.en: Rain falling very heavily, as if poured from a vessel.
meaning.zh: 雨下得很大，像是往下倒水一样。

examples.zh: 那天大雨如注，航班全部取消了。
examples.en: It was pouring with rain that day and all flights were cancelled.

examples.zh: 我们在大雨如注中赶到了车站。
examples.en: We reached the station in torrential rain.

usage.en: Predicate or adverbial; for weather scenes.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、状语，描写天气。

natural: a huge hulk of a thing

meaning.en: Something enormous, often imposing or intimidating.
meaning.zh: 形状或体积非常庞大的东西，常带有吓人的意味。

examples.zh: 港口里停着一艘庞然大物般的货轮。
examples.en: A cargo ship like a colossus was moored in the harbour.

examples.zh: 这家公司已成为行业里的庞然大物。
examples.en: The company has become a behemoth of the industry.

usage.en: Noun; also used of big organisations. Often ironic.
usage.zh: 作名词，也可指大型机构，常带调侃。

meaning.en: A situation in which innocent behaviour can easily be mistaken for wrongdoing.
meaning.zh: 比喻容易引起嫌疑的地方。

examples.zh: 为避免瓜田李下之嫌，他主动回避了这次评审。
examples.en: To avoid any appearance of impropriety, he recused himself from the review.

examples.zh: 身为财务主管，应当远离瓜田李下的是非。
examples.en: As finance head, you should stay clear of anything that looks suspect.

story.en: A Han ballad advises: do not stoop to fix your shoe in a melon field or straighten your hat under a plum tree, lest you be thought a thief (瓜田不纳履，李下不整冠).
story.zh: 《君子行》：“君子防未然，不处嫌疑间。瓜田不纳履，李下不正冠。”

usage.en: Often in 避/免瓜田李下之嫌.
usage.zh: 常说“避瓜田李下之嫌”。

synonyms: 瓜田不纳履，李下不整冠

meaning.en: To give others something they can use against you.
meaning.zh: 把把柄交给别人，使自己处于被动。

equivalents: hand someone a stick to beat you with

examples.zh: 他在邮件里乱说话，等于授人以柄。
examples.en: By saying careless things in his email he handed his critics ammunition.

examples.zh: 做事要谨慎，别授人以柄。
examples.en: Be careful and don't give others a handle against you.

usage.zh: 多作谓语，常用于告诫。

meaning.en: To give rewards in proportion to each person's contribution.
meaning.zh: 按功劳大小给予奖赏。

examples.zh: 年终会上，公司论功行赏，奖励了销售团队。
examples.en: At the year-end meeting the company rewarded the sales team according to merit.

examples.zh: 项目成功后，老板论功行赏。
examples.en: After the project succeeded, the boss handed out rewards by contribution.

usage.zh: 多作谓语，较正式。

meaning.en: A fertile, well-watered area on the northern frontier, as lush as the south; especially Ningxia's Yinchuan plain.
meaning.zh: 指塞外水土丰美、像江南一样的地方，尤指宁夏平原。

equivalents: a southern oasis in the north

examples.zh: 宁夏素有“塞上江南”的美誉。
examples.en: Ningxia is known as the “Jiangnan beyond the Great Wall”.

examples.zh: 这片塞上江南，稻浪翻滚。
examples.en: In this green frontier land, waves of rice rolled in the wind.

usage.en: Noun; a proper epithet in travel writing.
usage.zh: 作名词，多见于游记、宣传。

meaning.en: The four stages of a composition: opening, development, turn and conclusion.
meaning.zh: 指诗文章法的四个步骤：开头、承接、转折、收束。

examples.zh: 这首绝句起承转合，十分严谨。
examples.en: This quatrain follows the four-part structure with great rigour.

examples.zh: 老师讲解了文章的起承转合。
examples.en: The teacher explained the opening, development, turn and conclusion of the essay.

usage.zh: 作名词，用于谈论文章结构。

meaning.en: Narrow-minded, stingy or ungenerous in manner.
meaning.zh: 形容人举止不大方，气量小，吝啬。

examples.zh: 别这么小家子气，请大家吃顿饭吧。
examples.en: Don't be so petty. Treat everyone to a meal.

examples.zh: 她出手大方，一点也不小家子气。
examples.en: She's generous and not at all petty.

usage.zh: 作谓语、定语，含贬义。

natural: when the man goes, the policy goes

meaning.en: When a leader dies or leaves, his policies lapse with him.
meaning.zh: 人一死，他所主张的政策也随之废止。

equivalents: a legacy that doesn't outlast its founder

examples.zh: 他走后，这些改革人亡政息。
examples.en: After he left, his reforms lapsed with him.

examples.zh: 制度建设不到位，就容易人亡政息。
examples.en: Without proper institutions, policies tend to die with their champions.

story.en: The Doctrine of the Mean says good government depends on the man: when he lives his policies flourish; when he dies they cease.
story.zh: 《中庸》：“其人存，则其政举；其人亡，则其政息。”

usage.zh: 多作谓语，用于政治语境。

meaning.en: Heroes emerge because the times and circumstances call for them.
meaning.zh: 杰出人物是在特定的时代形势下涌现出来的。

examples.zh: 时势造英雄，乱世出了不少豪杰。
examples.en: The times make the hero; the age of chaos produced many great men.

examples.zh: 人们常说时势造英雄，也要有人抓住机会。
examples.en: They say the times make the hero, but someone has to seize the chance.

usage.en: Stand-alone saying, often paired with 英雄造时势.
usage.zh: 独立成句，常与“英雄造时势”对举。

meaning.en: To be so pampered that one does nothing for oneself; usually paired with 衣来伸手.
meaning.zh: 形容养尊处优、自己不动手，常与“衣来伸手”连用。

equivalents: be waited on hand and foot

examples.zh: 他从小衣来伸手，饭来张口。
examples.en: From childhood he has had everything done for him.

examples.zh: 过着饭来张口的日子，难怪什么都不会。
examples.en: Living with meals served to him, no wonder he can't do anything.

usage.en: Usually 衣来伸手，饭来张口.
usage.zh: 常说“衣来伸手，饭来张口”。

meaning.en: Disreputable or improper; also dubious and ill-defined.
meaning.zh: 形容不正派、不像样，或不伦不类。

examples.zh: 别跟那些不三不四的人来往。
examples.en: Don't mix with those shady characters.

examples.zh: 他说话不三不四，让人反感。
examples.en: The way he talks is improper and off-putting.

usage.en: Attributive or predicate; critical and colloquial.
usage.zh: 作定语、谓语，口语，含贬义。

meaning.en: All sorts of evil spirits and monsters; figuratively, all kinds of wicked people.
meaning.zh: 各种妖精、魔鬼和怪物，比喻各种邪恶的人和势力。

examples.zh: 《西游记》里有各式各样的妖魔鬼怪。
examples.en: Journey to the West has all kinds of demons and monsters.

examples.zh: 他把对手说成妖魔鬼怪。
examples.en: He painted his opponents as monsters.

usage.zh: 作名词，可实指也可比喻。

meaning.en: The circumstances are so pressing that one must act at once.
meaning.zh: 形势紧迫，迫使人不得不行动。

examples.zh: 市场变化太快，形势逼人，我们必须转型。
examples.en: The market changes so fast that circumstances force us to transform.

examples.zh: 形势逼人，不容再犹豫。
examples.en: The situation presses; there's no more room for hesitation.

usage.zh: 作谓语或句首，较正式。

meaning.en: To band together closely, whether in solidarity or as a clique.
meaning.zh: 紧紧联合在一起，可指团结，也可指结成小团体。

examples.zh: 大家抱成一团，共同对付困难。
examples.en: Everyone banded together to face the difficulty.

examples.zh: 小企业只有抱成一团，才能谈判。
examples.en: Small firms can only negotiate if they band together.

usage.zh: 作谓语，褒贬视语境。

meaning.en: Rank, reputation, wealth and official salary; worldly success.
meaning.zh: 功业、名声、利益和官俸，泛指世俗的名利。

examples.zh: 他看淡功名利禄，隐居山林。
examples.en: He saw fame and fortune as nothing and retired to the hills.

examples.zh: 别被功名利禄蒙住了眼睛。
examples.en: Don't let the pursuit of fame and fortune blind you.

usage.en: Object; often with 看淡/追求.
usage.zh: 多作宾语，常与“看淡”“追求”搭配。

synonyms: 世人都晓神仙好，惟有功名忘不了

meaning.en: A fine time and a lucky day, especially for weddings and big events.
meaning.zh: 美好的时辰和吉利的日子，多指适合办喜事的日子。

examples.zh: 他们挑了个良辰吉日举行婚礼。
examples.en: They picked an auspicious day for the wedding.

examples.zh: 开业要选良辰吉日。
examples.en: Choose a lucky date for the opening.

usage.zh: 作名词。

meaning.en: To fight a hundred battles without danger of defeat.
meaning.zh: 多次作战都不会陷入危险；常指知己知彼则立于不败之地。

examples.zh: 知己知彼，才能百战不殆。
examples.en: Know yourself and your enemy and you will never be in peril.

examples.zh: 这支队伍训练有素，百战不殆。
examples.en: This well-trained unit has never been in danger of defeat.

story.en: Sunzi says: know the enemy and know yourself, and in a hundred battles you will never be in peril (知彼知己，百战不殆).
story.zh: 《孙子·谋攻》：“知彼知己，百战不殆。”

date.zh: 春秋末至战国 · 前5世纪
date.en: late Spring and Autumn to Warring States, 5th c. BC

usage.zh: 常接在“知己知彼”之后。

meaning.en: Rewards and punishments are clearly and fairly distinguished.
meaning.zh: 奖励和惩罚界限清楚，公正无私。

equivalents: a clear system of incentives and sanctions

examples.zh: 这位经理奖罚分明，大家都服气。
examples.en: The manager rewards and punishes fairly, and everyone accepts it.

examples.zh: 军队必须奖罚分明。
examples.en: An army must keep rewards and penalties clear.

usage.zh: 作谓语、定语。

antonyms: 又要马儿跑，又要马儿不吃草

meaning.en: So coarse or unpleasant that one can't bear to hear it.
meaning.zh: 难听得让人受不了，多指粗俗或刺耳的话。

examples.zh: 他嘴里尽是些不堪入耳的脏话。
examples.en: His mouth was full of filthy language unfit to hear.

examples.zh: 邻居的歌声简直不堪入耳。
examples.en: The neighbour's singing is simply unbearable.

usage.en: Predicate or complement of 话/声音.
usage.zh: 作谓语，多说话语、声音。

meaning.en: To absorb what is useful from foreign cultures and make it serve one's own country.
meaning.zh: 吸收外国的有益东西，为中国所用。

equivalents: adapt foreign ideas to local needs
learn from abroad and put it to use at home

examples.zh: 发展经济要古为今用，洋为中用。
examples.en: Economic development should make the past serve the present and the foreign serve China.

examples.zh: 他倡导洋为中用，引进先进技术。
examples.en: He advocated making foreign experience serve China by introducing advanced technology.

usage.en: Slogan; usually paired with 古为今用.
usage.zh: 口号式用语，常与“古为今用”连用。

meaning.en: To pose as a person of culture without real taste or learning.
meaning.zh: 本身缺乏文化修养，却装作爱好文学艺术，以显示风雅。

equivalents: dabble in culture to show off

examples.zh: 他书房里摆满名著，其实只是附庸风雅。
examples.en: His study is full of classics, but it's only for show.

examples.zh: 有些人买画只是附庸风雅。
examples.en: Some people buy paintings merely to look cultured.

usage.zh: 作谓语，含贬义。

meaning.en: A mother's great efforts to find a good environment for her child's upbringing.
meaning.zh: 比喻母亲为孩子选择良好的成长环境而用心良苦。

equivalents: a parent's care for a child's environment

examples.zh: 为了孩子上学，她像孟母三迁一样搬了家。
examples.en: For her child's schooling she moved house, like Mencius's mother.

examples.zh: 孟母三迁的故事说明环境对孩子的影响。
examples.en: The story of Mencius's mother moving three times shows how environment shapes a child.

story.en: Mencius's mother moved from beside a graveyard, then a market, to next to a school so that her son would learn proper conduct.
story.zh: 刘向《列女传》载：孟子幼时，母亲为择邻而三次搬家，最后定居学宫旁。

usage.en: Noun or allusion; used when discussing parenting and schools.
usage.zh: 作名词或典故，多谈教育、择校。

meaning.en: With the country facing a great crisis.
meaning.zh: 国家面临严重灾难。

equivalents: in the nation's hour of crisis

examples.zh: 国难当头，人人有责。
examples.en: With the nation in peril, everyone has a duty.

examples.zh: 国难当头之际，他毅然从军。
examples.en: In the nation's hour of crisis, he resolutely joined the army.

usage.zh: 作状语，较正式，带爱国色彩。
